subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: Should shared/private dashboard tabs be a store-enforced authorization boundary, a UI convenience filter, or a deferred roadmap detail?
rationale: The request crosses Control UI visibility, operator scopes, privacy expectations, and persistent dashboard state; automation cannot choose the security promise safely.

options.title: Store-Enforced Privacy Boundary
options.body: After the dashboard base lands, add tab visibility to the schema/store/UI with migration, docs, and security proof for private-tab non-leakage.

options.title: UI-Only Convenience Filter
options.body: Treat shared/private tabs as an operator ergonomics feature and document that it is not strong separation between untrusted people.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap
options.body: Keep the broader roadmap tracker as the only planning item if maintainers do not want a separate subissue for this Tier 3 detail.

recommendation.title: Store-Enforced Privacy Boundary
recommendation.body: After the dashboard base lands, add tab visibility to the schema/store/UI with migration, docs, and security proof for private-tab non-leakage.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and related product/security boundary.
